title: TAF (terminal aerodrome forecast)
description: A TAF as raw text with FM, TEMPO, BECMG and PROB groups. Times are UTC; the valid period is DDHH/DDHH. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

taf.description: The raw TAF, one group line per line
examples:
TAF KILN 211720Z 2118/2224 24010KT P6SM SCT050
  FM212100 22015G25KT 3SM TSRA BKN025CB
  TEMPO 2121/2124 1SM +TSRA OVC015CB
  FM220000 30008KT P6SM SKC
AMD: thunderstorm timing moved up one hour.
